entities.summary: Jac Morgan is a Welsh rugby union player, who plays in the backrow for the Ospreys, Wales, and the British and Irish Lions. He was the captain of the Wales national rugby union team. He is a fluent Welsh speaker. Jac Morgan was a athletes & competitors from Carmarthen (b. 2000-01-21, Carmarthen).
